text: We live abroad and our kids have israeli passport. We ask my mother in law to write a letter for us where she explaines that we will be staying in her house, and she misses her grandchildren etc (she signes the letter with her personal details, we print it and keep it with us just in case). In 11 years of marriage, only once they kind of delayed us, than we showed the letter and we were let go. Maybe something similar can help.
